opening_message:

  - employment type: contractor
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Jennifer Miller (E017) is a contractor Analyst. Contractors are limited to read unless they have advanced security training (write); admin is never allowed. HR records do not show training, so the safe maximum is read. Recommend read for Source Code; write would require confirmation of advanced security training.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB confirms E017 (Jennifer Miller) is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors may have write only with advanced training; with basic training the maximum is read. Requested write exceeds maximum, so recommend read for Source Code.
reason: Jennifer Miller (E017) is a contractor. Contractors may have write only with advanced security training; Security DB confirms she has basic training only, so her maximum access is read. The requested write exceeds the maximum, so grant the maximum of read for Source Code.

content.text:
Let me work through this.

Employee: Jennifer Miller (E017), contractor Analyst.
Request: write access to Source Code.

Policy: contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

HR note: no training shown, recommend read.
Security note: security training basic → maximum read.

So the maximum is read. Requested write is above maximum, so grant maximum = read.

Submit decision: read.
